selection.decision: Use OFSA 48x1536 INT4 1200MHz as the Scenario B research baseline; INT2 remains accuracy-gated and no architecture is product-signed.
selection.precision_ppa_note: Current PPA treats INT2 and INT4 modes on the same hardware as equal-area/equal-power; a dedicated INT2 packing/datapath implementation must be modeled as a separate hardware variant.
